plugin.name: Safe (Recommended)
plugin.description:
Active bounded archive warming. Keeps the narrow SkyrimSE.exe import hook and unchanged save/write/async safety gates. It observes successful read-only BSA/BA2 opens under game Data and warms those archives through separate read-only buffered handles, including archives opened later during the work window.
Limits: 1024 MB per process session, 64 MB per archive, 512 distinct archives, 64 MB/s aggregate, one low-priority worker, 15 seconds after SKSE DataLoaded and a 180-second work window. Drive-only tuning reduces rate to 32 MB/s on SATA SSD, 8 MB/s on HDD and 16 MB/s when detection is inconclusive; HDD budget is reduced to 256 MB. RAM reserve checks run between chunks and save-load messages pause reads.
No random-access hint, process-wide hook, full hardware enumeration, working-set expansion or DirectStorage. Logs report completed reads and explain inactivity. Cache retention and in-game performance depend on Windows and the workload.

plugin.name: Minimal (troubleshooting)
plugin.description: Warming-disabled control for troubleshooting and comparison. Same narrow executable-only archive flag policy as Safe, with random-access hints and process changes disabled. No background archive reads, hardware probing or automatic tuning. Statistics remain enabled so an inactive flag policy is visible in the log.

plugin.name: Experimental (unproven - benchmark it)
plugin.description:
Larger archive warmer with process-wide Detours interception, the random-access archive hint, hardware profiling and the legacy EcoQoS opt-out. These options change a wider part of the process than Safe.
Limits: 2048 MB per process session, 128 MB per archive, 512 observed archives, 128 MB/s aggregate, one worker, 30 seconds after DataLoaded, a 180-second work window and strided sampling. Drive and RAM checks can only reduce these limits. Save-load messages pause warming. DirectStorage stays disabled.
Compare loading and traversal against Safe and Minimal using the same save and route. This profile has no measured gameplay advantage.
